title: From demand to departure.
subtitle: A passenger becomes a booking, a schedule, a flight — and a service outcome.

activities.label: Passengers & booking
activities.purpose: Connect customer needs to routes, prices and bookings. Current conversational discovery returns users to easyJet booking sites.
activities.pressure: Capacity, aircraft availability, fuel and service recovery affect operating economics; no cost share or causal benefit is estimated.

activities.label: Network & pricing

activities.pressure: Capacity, aircraft availability, fuel and service recovery affect operating economics; no cost share or causal benefit is estimated.

activities.label: Aircraft & crew
activities.purpose: Prepare and allocate aircraft and people for the schedule; enabling tools are not proof of utilisation or causal benefits.
activities.pressure: Capacity, aircraft availability, fuel and service recovery affect operating economics; no cost share or causal benefit is estimated.

activities.label: Airports & flight operations
activities.purpose: Coordinate airports, ground activity and aircraft availability. Exact provider workshare and operational interfaces remain unknown.
activities.pressure: Capacity, aircraft availability, fuel and service recovery affect operating economics; no cost share or causal benefit is estimated.

activities.label: Maintenance & engineering
activities.purpose: Anticipate and resolve aircraft defects. Historical Skywise / S.FP+ context must not become assumed current contract scope.
activities.pressure: Capacity, aircraft availability, fuel and service recovery affect operating economics; no cost share or causal benefit is estimated.

activities.label: Disruption & recovery
activities.purpose: Manage flight/crew disruption and customer care. Obtain adoption, deflection and disruption-mix baselines before attributing outcomes to AI.
activities.pressure: Capacity, aircraft availability, fuel and service recovery affect operating economics; no cost share or causal benefit is estimated.

activities.label: Data & digital systems
activities.purpose: Connect customer and operational workflows. Jetstream and conversational interfaces have different scope and dates.
activities.pressure: Capacity, aircraft availability, fuel and service recovery affect operating economics; no cost share or causal benefit is estimated.

activities.label: Fuel & sustainability
activities.purpose: Manage cost and environmental pressures. Separate supplier obligations, airline roles, forecasts and measured performance.
activities.pressure: Capacity, aircraft availability, fuel and service recovery affect operating economics; no cost share or causal benefit is estimated.

activities.label: Service & travel outcomes
activities.purpose: Inspect dated operating and financial measures. A half-year result is not a full-year comparator or an AI attribution study.
